Run the three “Next Commands” in order from the repo root. They will (1) select and promote the best module candidate, (2) run system-level candidate evals, and (3) generate a “next fix” report.

```bash
# 1) Run AUB autopilot, evaluate candidates, and select/promote best
python3 experiment_system/tools/aub_autopilot.py \
  --registry experiment_system/config/module_registry.yaml \
  --run --select-best

# 2) Run system autopilot over system candidates
python3 experiment_system/tools/system_autopilot.py \
  --spec experiment_system/config/system_candidates.yaml \
  --run

# 3) Generate next-fix guidance report
python3 experiment_system/tools/aub_next_fix.py \
  --registry experiment_system/config/module_registry.yaml \
  --output baseline/reports/next_fix.md
```

If you want a clean, reproducible run, do it in a fresh env and capture logs:

```bash
set -euo pipefail
mkdir -p baseline/reports logs

python3 experiment_system/tools/aub_autopilot.py --registry experiment_system/config/module_registry.yaml --run --select-best | tee logs/aub_autopilot.log
python3 experiment_system/tools/system_autopilot.py --spec experiment_system/config/system_candidates.yaml --run | tee logs/system_autopilot.log
python3 experiment_system/tools/aub_next_fix.py --registry experiment_system/config/module_registry.yaml --output baseline/reports/next_fix.md | tee logs/next_fix.log
```

Paste back:
- the final lines of each log (or any stack trace),
- and the updated `baseline/reports/next_fix.md`,
and I can help interpret results / decide next actions.
